ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 68 / OppVR88] Low/Medium Touch Opportunities require a Regression Reason when moving Negotiation->Solutioning/Qualification or Solutioning->Qualification. Confirmed needed by IRM, no logic change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, 'Low Touch'), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, 'Medium Touch') ),
OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Negotiation'), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification')) ),
ISBLANK(Stage_Regression_Reason__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Regression Reason is required. Please enter a reason for moving this Opportunity backwards.
